integrity.proof_method: Direct swap-neutrality and exact vertex-class counting; standalone exhaustive finite rational tests

scientific_limitations: Only fully occupied two-color complete multipartite graphs with common symmetric half-peaked closed-neighborhood utilities and strictly bilateral swaps are covered.
Adjacent cross-part complementarity follows the swap identity already in Bilò et al. (2022); the new component is the entire exact biclique integration distribution and sharp efficiency extrema.
Finite enumeration is a corroboration of the mathematical proof, and external independent audit has not been performed.
An unindexed equivalent prior result remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Complete bipartite integration spectra in symmetric single-peaked swap Schelling games
